Alex K: Quick check — are we OK with the cache-hit header semantics for prefix cache? I prototyped a response header format: `X-Redwood-Cache: hit;key=pref:sha256:<hex>;ttl=120` — but want to confirm compatibility with streaming and partial hits. TL;DR: can client treat any `hit` as full response from cache and skip streaming request? Need consensus.

Maya R: Short: No, not always. For streaming + partial prefix hits we return hit + partial=true. Client must still open streaming connection unless header includes `complete=true`.

Alex K: Where is `partial` documented? I couldn't find it in contract. Should we add `complete` flag instead to make it explicit? Also need guidance for SDKs fallback behavior.

Sam T: Proposal: header `X-Redwood-Cache: status=hit|miss;scope=prefix|response;complete=true|false;key=<id>;ttl=<s>` Example:
```http
X-Redwood-Cache: status=hit;scope=prefix;complete=false;key=pref:abcd;ttl=60
``` 
Clients: if status=hit && complete=true -> use cached HTTP body and close. If complete=false -> keep streaming.

Lina P: Ops note: server can set `scope=response` for embeddings where whole response cached. Important for backward compat: old clients should still be fine if header is absent (default miss). Add feature-flagged rollout.

Alex K: Sounds good. Two more Qs: 1) invalidation: do we support explicit invalidation signals via `POST /cache/invalidate`? 2) cache-key derivation: should keys include model/version + tokenizer hash + prefix-truncation-length? I want to avoid silent misses.

Sam T: Invalidation: yes, we have internal admin API `POST /_internal/cache/invalidate` with namespaces. For public contract we'll expose `X-Redwood-Invalidate` event to webhook or pubsub; not synchronous. For key derivation: include model+ver+prompt_normalization (strip whitespace + param hash) + prefix_len bucketed. Avoid full prompt in key.

Maya R: SDK behavior: default SDK should treat cache headers as advisory. Only the hosted SDK will short-circuit when `complete=true` and `scope=response`. Other SDKs must default to streaming path. Add opt-in for 'strict_cache_short_circuit'.

Lina P: Perf concern: TTL estimation — recommend we provide `ttl` but also `source_age` to indicate staleness when using fallback merges. e.g., `source_age=5` (seconds since cached).

Alex K: Ok can someone open a tiny PR to update the API contract doc and add tests for streaming + partial hit? Pinging @Sam T for tests and @Maya R for SDK changes. I'll add a lightweight integration test matrix.

Sam T: Will do, creating ticket and PR today. I'll add coverage for: header parsing, short-circuit, partial+stream merge. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-987

Maya R: I'll add SDK flag and doc note. FYI we should add a deprecation policy for old header `X-Redwood-Cache: hit` (no attrs) to avoid ambiguity.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled for 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC to roll feature-flag. :rocket:

Alex K: thanks all :thumbsup:
